problems.issue: Reliance on a third-party social media platform (Facebook) as the primary business web presence instead of an owned domain.
problems.impact: Limits brand control, search engine optimization (SEO) potential, custom functionality, and professional credibility.

problems.issue: Authentication wall (login redirect) restricts public access and search engine indexing of business content.
problems.impact: Potential customers without a Facebook account cannot view business information, services, or contact details, severely reducing conversion opportunities.

opportunities: Develop a dedicated, SEO-optimized business website to serve as the central hub for conversions and lead generation.
Integrate a clear call-to-action (CTA) strategy on landing pages to capture customer inquiries directly.
Use social media platforms like Facebook strictly as top-of-funnel marketing channels to drive traffic back to the official website.
audit.summary: The business currently relies solely on a Facebook page, which restricts public accessibility via login walls and limits SEO and brand autonomy. Establishing a dedicated website is critical for maximizing customer reach and conversion potential.

outreach.subject: Quick thought on MaxSmile Dental Clinic's online reach
outreach.body:
Hi there,

I was looking at MaxSmile Dental Clinic's Facebook page and noticed that visitors without an account hit a login wall. That means potential patients searching for your Manila clinic are missing out on your services and contact details.

Depending entirely on social media also limits your Google search visibility and brand control.

We put together a quick, dedicated website demo for you that fixes this completely and makes it easy for new patients to find you.

Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,
Rahul

---

We actually put together a quick, clean prototype of what a dedicated site could look like for you.
